sub_strands.name: Whole Numbers and Integers
performance_indicators: Apply divisibility test rules for 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, and 11 to solve numerical puzzles.
Represent, order, and perform basic operations on directed integers using a number line.
Solve real-life arithmetic problems involving prime factorization, LCM, and GCD contextually.

sub_strands.name: Fractions, Decimals, and Percentages
performance_indicators: Perform operations on decimals up to three decimal places including recurring decimals.
Apply basic data extraction techniques to compute percentage fractions in consumer contexts.

sub_strands.name: Rate, Ratio, and Conversion
performance_indicators: Express quantities as ratios and share amounts using given proportional metrics.
Calculate conversion rates involving foreign currencies based on current financial charts.
Determine distance-time rates using derived constant speed calculations.

sub_strands.name: Linear Equations and Properties of Polygons
performance_indicators: Formulate and solve word problems involving single-variable linear equations.
Investigate and prove angle properties of parallel lines intersected by a transversal line.
Construct triangles and regular quadrilaterals using geometric instruments precisely.

sub_strands.name: Critical Listening and Intonation
performance_indicators: Identify central claims and subtextual nuances in verbal announcements or podcasts.
Demonstrate functional control over stress, rhythm, and falling/rising intonation patterns in presentations.

sub_strands.name: Intensive Reading and Set Text Analysis
performance_indicators: Analyze short stories and selected youth plays to map plot structures, character motivations, and moral messages.
Differentiate between literal statements and figurative expressions (similes, metaphors, personification) in poetry.

sub_strands.name: Grammar and Functional Writing
performance_indicators: Apply coordinating and subordinating conjunctions to formulate compound-complex sentences.
Draft clear, structured functional texts including formal letters, book reviews, and imaginative short stories.

sub_strands.name: Mjadala na Utangazaji
performance_indicators: Kusikiliza ripoti za habari na kutoa tathmini ya kina kuhusu ukweli wa mambo.
Kutumia msamiati mwafaka na lugha ya heshima kuwasilisha maoni kwenye mijadala ya darasani.

sub_strands.name: Ufahamu na Fasihi Simulizi
performance_indicators: Kusoma na kufafanua tanzu za fasihi simulizi kama vile methali, vitendawili na ngano za mashujaa.
Kuchambuzi makala ya kitaaluma huku ukionyesha muundo wa hoja na mtiririko wa mawazo.

sub_strands.name: Uandishi wa Kina na Miundo ya Lugha
performance_indicators: Kuandika insha za wasifu, hotuba na barua za kirafiki kwa kufuata kanuni za lugha sanifu.
Kutumia viambishi, nyakati, na kukanusha vitenzi katika ngeli mbalimbali kwa usahihi.

sub_strands.name: Separation of Mixtures and Acids/Bases
performance_indicators: Perform physical separation tasks using filtration, evaporation, crystallization, and simple distillation.
Classify household items as acidic, basic, or neutral using litmus paper and natural indicator extracts.
Demonstrate safe laboratory behavior and correct assembly of basic science apparatus.

sub_strands.name: Cellular Structure and Excretory Organs
performance_indicators: Identify parts of a basic light microscope and handle it correctly to view simple biological cells.
Illustrate the structural framework and functions of human skin and kidney organs.

sub_strands.name: Forms of Energy and Heat Transfer
performance_indicators: Investigate heat transfer mechanisms (conduction, convection, radiation) through laboratory models.
Evaluate renewable and non-renewable energy sources and discuss local conservation techniques.

sub_strands.name: Geometric Construction and Hand Tools
performance_indicators: Draw basic plane geometry outlines using standard drawing instruments and layout margins.
Identify, classify, and apply safety measures when using metalwork, woodwork, and plastic processing hand tools.
Differentiate between ferrous and non-ferrous metals based on physical structural profiles.

sub_strands.name: Computer Systems and Basic Logic
performance_indicators: Configure input, output, and secondary storage units within a modern computing system safely.
Construct sequential algorithms and represent data patterns using basic flowchart symbols.

sub_strands.name: Business Ideas and Financial Literacy
performance_indicators: Identify potential community business opportunities based on market demand gap assessments.
Maintain accurate records for basic business transactions using cash book entries.

sub_strands.name: Soil Pollution and Water Retention
performance_indicators: Demonstrate field actions to minimize soil pollution from agricultural synthetic wastes.
Construct micro-catchment water retention structures to maximize soil moisture levels.
Select and plant specific indigenous trees suited to environmental micro-climates.

sub_strands.name: Crop Establishment and Cooking Methods
performance_indicators: Execute seedbed preparation, planting, and initial care for select vegetable crops.
Apply diverse cooking techniques including steaming, grilling, and roasting safely.
Design and establish framed suspended gardens using local recycled equipment.

sub_strands.name: Laundry and Soap Making
performance_indicators: Demonstrate appropriate laundry care processes for loose-colored household textiles.
Formulate basic homemade multi-purpose soaps following precise measurement metrics.

sub_strands.name: African Continent Profile and Weather Systems
performance_indicators: Locate Africa on a world grid system and identify its primary boundaries and sea links.
Examine the formation and geographic spread of major physical features across the African continent.
Interpret regional meteorological charts using advanced indicators and isobar configurations.

sub_strands.name: Early Man and African Communities
performance_indicators: Analyze the theories of human origin and trace key archaeological evidence found within East Africa.
Examine the social, economic, and political setups of select pre-colonial African societies.

sub_strands.name: Human Rights, Governance, and Self-Awareness
performance_indicators: Outline the components of the Bill of Rights inside the Constitution of Kenya.
Demonstrate self-awareness, assertive communication, and refusal skills to combat social peer pressures.
Evaluate conflict mitigation patterns that support administrative stability inside school communities.

sub_strands.name: Graphic Design and Weaving Techniques
performance_indicators: Design communicative poster typography using color balances and manual perspective templates.
Create functional items utilizing traditional multi-strand weaving or plaiting skills.
Apply basic printmaking techniques to replicate unified decorative motifs on fabric surfaces.

sub_strands.name: Sight Reading and Performance Execution
performance_indicators: Read and interpret simple musical notation structures including staff lines and time signatures.
Perform folk dances from diverse Kenyan communities observing exact rhythmic expressions and costuming.

sub_strands.name: Track Events and Technical Officiating
performance_indicators: Execute standard starting blocks positions for sprint races and perform proper baton handovers in relays.
Apply rules and display core physical skills for selected team games (handball, hockey, or basketball).

sub_strands.name: Creation, Fall, and Christian Virtues
performance_indicators: Contrast the biblical accounts of creation and draw connections to environmental conservation duties.
Analyze the consequences of human disobedience as illustrated in the Genesis accounts.
Apply the core fruits of the Holy Spirit to reinforce personal integrity and peer equity inside school interactions.

sub_strands.name: Quranic Exegesis and Pillars of Iman
performance_indicators: Translate and explain the ethical implications outlined in Surah Al-Infitar and Surah Al-Mutaffifin.
Formulate a clear narrative detailing the attributes of Allah through the pillars of Iman.
Practice proper purification routines (Wudhu and Ghusl) following established jurisprudential protocols.
